title: Gerhard vs Bellarmine: some regenerate sins exclude from the kingdom in act; others do not cast out Spirit
source_text: LVI. Postea vero ad quaedam loca a Bellarmino objecta respondens, Hoc saltem inquit, ex illis & similibus dictis probari potest, esse quoddam peccatorum discrimen; ita ut quaedam a renatis committantur, nec tamen e regno coelorum actu eos excludant, quae-dam vero, si a renatis committantur, fidem & Spiritum Sanctum excutiant, quod nos non negamus. Capite jam citato num. 100. Deinde numero sequenti subjungit, quod Renatis saepe in levissimis, aliquando incautis obrepat peccatum per quod non desinunt esse justi. Et quibusdam interjectis, Ubi vera, inquit, in Christum fides, per cha-ritatem efficax, ibi homo spiritualiter vivit, hanc spiritualem vitam non amittit per naevos peccata ignorantiae & infirmitatis, modo ea agnoscat, deploret, & Christo ad-haerens spiritu concupiscentias carnis mortificet, sed per peccata contra conscientiam ad-missa, per quae Spiritus Sanctus excutitur, fides & vita spiritualis amittitur.
pass_a_gloss: Afterwards indeed, answering certain places objected by Bellarmine, This at least, he says, can be proved from those and like sayings: that there is a certain discrimination of sins; so that some are committed by the regenerate and yet do not actually exclude them from the kingdom of heaven, while others, if committed by the regenerate, shake off faith and the Holy Spirit—which we do not deny. In the chapter already cited, no. 100. Then in the following number he adds that to the regenerate there often creeps in, in the lightest matters, sometimes unawares, a sin through which they do not cease to be just. And after some things interposed: Where true faith in Christ, efficacious through charity, is, he says, there a man lives spiritually; he does not lose this spiritual life through blemishes—sins of ignorance and infirmity—provided he acknowledge them, deplore them, and clinging to Christ mortify the lusts of the flesh by the Spirit; but through sins admitted against conscience, by which the Holy Spirit is shaken off, faith and spiritual life are lost.
pass_b_english: Against Bellarmine Gerhard grants a real sin-discrimination among the regenerate.
Ignorance/infirmity blemishes leave spiritual life if resisted in Christ; conscience-sins cast out Spirit, faith, and life.

choices.english: do not cease to be just
choices.why: Lightest creeping faults need not unjustify.
